@@ -0,0 +1,7 @@
+### PR [#2297](https://github.com/danielmiessler/Fabric/pull/2297) by [pcbeingused333](https://github.com/pcbeingused333) and [ksylvan](https://github.com/ksylvan): fix(claude): omit temperature and top_p for Claude models that reject them on Bedrock gateway and Vertex AI
+
+- Fixed Claude requests by omitting `temperature` and `top_p` for models that reject them on the Bedrock gateway and Vertex AI.
+- Centralized Claude sampling parameter logic so it is shared across the Anthropic and Vertex AI integrations.
+- Preserved per-model restrictions and the mutually exclusive handling of sampling parameters.
+- Moved sampling tests into the shared Anthropic package for consistent coverage.
+- Added the corresponding changelog entry for this change.

+package anthropic
+
+import (
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-go"
+	"github.com/danielmiessler/fabric/internal/domain"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+// The anthropic and vertexai plugins set the sampling parameters through SetSamplingParams.
+func TestSetSamplingParamsOmitsThemForModelsThatRejectThem(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, model := range []string{"claude-opus-4-7@20260101", "claude-opus-5-5", "claude-sonnet-5-5@20260601"} {
+		t.Run(model, func(t *testing.T) {
+			for _, topP := range []float64{domain.DefaultTopP, 0.5} {
+				var params anthropic.MessageNewParams
+				SetSamplingParams(&params, &domain.ChatOptions{Model: model, Temperature: domain.DefaultTemperature, TopP: topP})
+
+				require.False(t, params.Temperature.Valid())
+				require.False(t, params.TopP.Valid())
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestSetSamplingParamsSetsOneOfThemForOtherModels(t *testing.T) {
+	var params anthropic.MessageNewParams
+	SetSamplingParams(&params, &domain.ChatOptions{Model: "claude-sonnet-4-6", Temperature: 0.3, TopP: domain.DefaultTopP})
+	require.True(t, params.Temperature.Valid())
+	require.False(t, params.TopP.Valid())
+
+	params = anthropic.MessageNewParams{}
+	SetSamplingParams(&params, &domain.ChatOptions{Model: "claude-sonnet-4-6", Temperature: 0.3, TopP: 0.5})
+	require.True(t, params.TopP.Valid())
+	require.False(t, params.Temperature.Valid())
+}

+package azureaigateway
+
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/danielmiessler/fabric/internal/chat"
+	"github.com/danielmiessler/fabric/internal/domain"
+	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
+)
+
+func prepareBedrockBody(t *testing.T, model string, topP float64) map[string]any {
+	t.Helper()
+
+	opts := &domain.ChatOptions{Model: model, Temperature: domain.DefaultTemperature, TopP: topP}
+	raw, err := NewBedrockBackend("key").PrepareRequest(
+		[]*chat.ChatCompletionMessage{{Role: chat.ChatMessageRoleUser, Content: "hi"}}, opts)
+	require.NoError(t, err)
+
+	var body map[string]any
+	require.NoError(t, json.Unmarshal(raw, &body))
+	return body
+}
+
+// Claude Opus 4.7 and later, and the Claude 5 models, reject temperature and top_p with a 400.
+func TestBedrockPrepareRequestOmitsSamplingForModelsThatRejectIt(t *testing.T) {
+	for _, model := range []string{
+		"us.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5-v1:0",
+		"global.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5",
+		"anthropic.claude-opus-4-7-v1:0",
+	} {
+		t.Run(model, func(t *testing.T) {
+			for _, topP := range []float64{domain.DefaultTopP, 0.5} {
+				body := prepareBedrockBody(t, model, topP)
+				require.NotContains(t, body, "temperature")
+				require.NotContains(t, body, "top_p")
+			}
+		})
+	}
+}
+
+func TestBedrockPrepareRequestKeepsSamplingForOtherModels(t *testing.T) {
+	body := prepareBedrockBody(t, "us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0", domain.DefaultTopP)
+	require.Contains(t, body, "temperature")
+	require.NotContains(t, body, "top_p")
+
+	body = prepareBedrockBody(t, "us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929-v1:0", 0.5)
+	require.Contains(t, body, "top_p")
+	require.NotContains(t, body, "temperature")
+}
